title.en: Lilo dresses up for the holidays.
title.fr: Lilo se met aux couleurs des fêtes.

introduction.en: The app icon picks up a festive touch on special days, drawn for each icon.
introduction.fr: L'icône de l'app prend une touche festive les jours de fête, dessinée pour chaque icône.

body.en: Halloween, Christmas, Lunar New Year, Easter and a few other days each get their own version of your icon. Turn it off in Settings > Appearance.
body.fr: Halloween, Noël, le Nouvel an lunaire, Pâques et quelques autres jours ont chacun leur version de votre icône. Désactivez-la dans Réglages > Apparence.

notes: Lilo's app icon dresses up for Halloween, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day, Lunar New Year, Easter, the summer solstice and its own birthday, in a version drawn for each icon. Turn it off in Settings > Appearance > Seasonal icon.
